modules.name: Classics and Legends combined
modules.note: Any of the 16 nations; commons from either box.

steps.text: Choose a nation; take all its cards (colour in the bottom left corner)
steps.note: Combining boxes: any of the 16 nations

steps.text: Power card left of your play area, either side up for the whole game (new players: B side)
Arthurians: King Arthur's Court below the power card. Utopians: Visions of Shangri-La on Gates of Shangri-La below it
Accession card (Vikings: zenith, Arthurians: nadir) faceup above the power card; Atlanteans and Utopians have none
Shuffle your nation cards facedown on top of it, sideways: your nation deck
Development cards (Arthurians: quests) faceup left of the nation deck
State card barbarian side up left of your cards (Atlanteans: empire side up)
Arthurians, Celts, Olmecs, Qin, Utopians, Vikings: add your unrest cards to the commons
Shuffle your remaining cards as your draw deck right of the power card; draw 5
All tokens as the supply; give each player 3 materials, 2 population, 1 progress, 5 exhaustion, 3 action
steps.note: A Utopian gets only 3 exhaustion; exhaustion and action tokens go on the state card

steps.text: Market board in the middle; sort the commons cards by suit (dual uncivilised/civilised counts as uncivilised)
Using commons from either box: replace any tributary card named like a chosen nation with a random tributary from the other box
Remove commons cards marked {icons}
Unrest cards faceup below the unrest icon: the unrest pile
King of Kings faceup (A side) above the fame icon; shuffle the other fame cards on it, sideways
Box the top {n} of the fame deck unseen
Region, uncivilised and civilised decks: {n} cards each, above their icons
Shuffle the leftover region, uncivilised and civilised cards with the tributary cards: the main deck
Market: 1 card from each suit deck and 2 from the main deck, faceup below the board
Tuck an unrest card under each uncivilised, civilised and tributary card in the market
A progress token on each civilised market card that has no uncivilised icon
The round ends when the player right of the solstice card finishes; then everyone resolves solstice
Placing your accession card in your discard flips your state card to empire
Scoring triggers (empty main deck, last development, King of Kings...): finish the round, then play one more
An empty unrest pile collapses the game at once: fewest unrest cards wins
Place the solstice card randomly between two players; the player on its left starts
